scope: Independent replay of the deployed snapshot (generated_at 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z) and its published pages via scripts/60019704_verify (219 checks), plus a first-hand HLTV-first and esportsbook research sweep (read 2026-10-26T00:51-01:05Z, data/research/60019704/) of every fixture that build leaves unpicked: 1082792 HOTU vs The Huns and the nine additional live lobby fixtures 1079201, 1079202, 1079203, 1081159, 1081160, 1081162, 1081163, 1081164, 1093218.
method: Every replay number was recomputed offline from the inputs the snapshot itself publishes (bid/ask midpoints, proportional no-vig normalisation, Valve fixed-RD Glicko expectation with RD 75) and compared exactly; every research observation was read first-hand through Arena's page-fetch tool and transcribed verbatim with URL and read time (raw bodies were not byte-archived; only the Valve standings file was fetched in full and SHA-256 hashed). Items that depend on source disagreements or provider behaviour the dashboard cannot control are marked 'needs review' or 'platform limitation' rather than silently guessed.

items.finding: All nine priced rows of the reviewed 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z build (archived verbatim beside this register so the dated claim stays reproducible) re-derive exactly from their published inputs: six Polymarket market rows from their two order-book midpoints (every spread within the 0.15 ceiling), the Thunderpick bookmaker row from proportional no-vig normalisation of odds 1.61/2.18, and the two Valve model rows (Rooster 718 vs Abyssal 734; 5star 1110 vs 1win 1383) from the fixed-RD Glicko expectation with RD 75. The four-hour publisher then re-collected and closed the gap: the 2026-10-26T01:33:57Z publish carries inventory 81, 19 open rows and 17 picks. Eight of the nine additions now carry picks (six from the Valve rating model: 1079201, 1081160, 1093218, 1081162, 1081163, 1081164; two from the bookmaker rung: 1079202 at 0.682/0.318 and 1079203 at 0.615/0.385 - lines that did not exist at this session read window of 00:51-01:05Z). The two remaining unresolved rows are exactly the hard-blocked pair this session documented: 1081159 (60A-05) and 1082792 (60A-04).
items.handling: Gap independently confirmed first-hand at 00:52Z (arena-500519ba first observed it at 00:44Z); closure verified against the 01:33:57Z publish. The dossier of this session supplied the per-fixture external evidence and the prediction of which fixtures would and would not resolve.

items.area: Tight Polymarket books unreachable by the strict market join
items.finding: Open Polymarket series ('Match Winner') markets exist for all four NODWIN quarterfinals and the Moscow Cyber Games semifinal. The Metizport vs Brute book reads bid 0.59 / ask 0.60 (spread 0.01) and the HOTU vs The Huns book bid 0.82 / ask 0.92 (spread 0.10, tightened from the 43-cent book recorded on 2026-10-25; outcome prices 0.87/0.13). None can bind under the exact-name plus 60-second rule: QF2-QF4 fail on start time (60A-03), QF1 on the outcome name 'Team Nemesis', QF3 additionally on 'UNiTY esports', and 1082792 on 'The Huns Esports' - even though a reviewed alias 'The Huns Esports' -> 'The Huns' scoped to Moscow Cyber Games 2026 already exists in the registry, because the market path in scripts/collect.py matches raw outcome names and does not consult it. Update (01:33:57Z publish): the bookmaker rung has since priced 1079202 (0.682/0.318) and 1079203 (0.615/0.385), so the unreachable Polymarket books no longer leave those fixtures pick-less; 1082792 remains unresolved, and the strict-join limitations (outcome-name matching without the alias registry, 60-second start window) remain in place for the record.
items.handling: Recorded as flag 6001-03. For 1082792 the start times agree exactly (2026-10-31T09:00:00Z on Hotspawn, Polymarket and HLTV), so applying the registry alias in the market path (or an equivalent outcome-name normalisation) would let the next collection price the now-tight book without touching the model rung. Implementation belongs to the ladder owner.

items.area: Pre-existing main defect surfaced by this session's full-suite gate
items.finding: While running the full local gate for this PR, tests/test_22a3ed80_verification.py (PublishedSummaryTests.test_no_hard_check_fails) fails on pristine origin/main at 90483962, independently of this session's changes (reproduced in a clean worktree). The committed landing page renders fixture 1093218 Nuclear TigeRES vs UNiTY as 'Nuclear TigeRES 58.3% / UNiTY 41.7% - Researched Consensus, Observed: median of 2 books', while the same tree's snapshot.json carries the featured Valve-model analysis [0.70665667, 0.29334333] (inputs Nuclear TigeRES 1324, UNiTY 1167 - the exact standings rows this session read first-hand). The executive summary's consensus layer and the snapshot's featured analysis layer therefore disagree for this fixture in the 2026-10-26T01:33:57Z publish, and the 22a3ed80 render-equality check (hard) fails. Six sessions have open PRs replaying the 19-row board at this moment; arena-f644ed1b (PR #372, 'Unblock refresh: verify sourced model-to-money consensus upgrades') owns the consensus layer.
items.handling: Recorded so the owning session can see the exact fixture and layers involved; this session's own PR adds no render code and its replay checks (snapshot-internal math, page ids and markers) pass on the same tree. Not fixed here: build.py and the consensus layer are outside this session's pledged scope.
